semantic.justification: JavaScript exception ABI explicitly links existing generated constructors and lazy native type getters; borrowed declared storage is copied by the actual generated class. Zero-argument getCaughtException uses synchronous host catch scope, with nesting restored. Original source misc catch/throw assertions pass; physical C++ binary mappings, machine code and native TLS are not certified. Actual UCB Any cancellation, CommandFailedException, Content isDocument/openStream and registered native CDocumentBuilder retain original defaults, callbacks and stream ownership. Original domtest stream QA passes. Real UCB/SimpleFileAccess providers, URI success/fallback service QA, metadata and full DOCX/XLSX shell/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Core and SDK consume platform-neutral metadata and an injected exception ABI contract; only composition imports and initializes the browser implementation.
